purpose: Provide source-SHA-bound hosted semantic call inventories for the current Stage1 source after historical 656-call/736-argument closure became stale. AST calls and typed O0 IR CALL instructions are independent semantic oracles; neither substitutes for native Stage1 physical call/call-argument high-water measurements.

ast.definition: Every typed AST CallExpression occurrence, including nested calls. Arguments are CallExpression.arguments occurrences.

o0_ir.definition: Every IROpcode.CALL in typed O0 IR. Operands/results use IRInstruction.operands/results and are not assumed to equal AST argument/result counts.

classification.internal: callee name is declared by a non-foreign source function
classification.foreign: callee name is declared by a source foreign function
classification.builtin_or_other: simple callee name is neither a source internal nor source foreign declaration
classification.dynamic_or_nonidentifier: AST callee is not a simple Identifier; IR CALL without a callee string is reported separately

prohibited_inference: AST call count equals native Stage1 physical call-record requirement
AST argument occurrence count equals native Stage1 call-argument-pool requirement
O0 IR CALL count equals native Stage1 physical call-record requirement
O0 IR operand count equals native Stage1 call-argument-pool requirement
historical 656 calls / 736 arguments remains current after source SHA changes
using this hosted report as native capacity evidence
